passed, 1 failed, 1 skipped. The only failures are `a size render …
keeps every color frame`, which also fail on `main` on this phone.

perf(Reanimated): collect updated views in updateLightTree only when a view moves (#10998)

> [!NOTE]
> This pull request was authored by AI on behalf of @tomekzaw.

## Summary

`updateLightTree` copied the old view of every Update into a map on each
commit, but reads the map only for views that move and their ancestors.
This fills it only when the transaction moves a view, in the same order
as before.

## Test plan

- Release `fabric-example` on a Samsung Galaxy A16, Bokeh example with a
fixed seed (100 views animating `transform` and `backgroundColor`
through `useAnimatedStyle`), 4 rounds interleaved with `main`, 12 s
Perfetto captures. `pullTransaction` per frame: 418 → 405 µs (−3.6%),
lower in all 4 rounds.
- Reanimated runtime tests (`ReleaseRuntimeTests`, Pixel 9a): 431
passed, 1 failed, 1 skipped. The only failures are `a size render …
keeps every color frame`, which also fail on `main` on this phone.
